findings.claim: The new default InkPaper rendering path has no instrumentation coverage.
findings.evidence: All instrumentation theme calls omit style and therefore render QUIET_GRID. No androidTest source references ThemeStyle, INK_PAPER, or MainActivity. ProductVisualTest, P8VisualTest, Pr17UiTest, authentication tests, and product E2E tests use synthetic activities. The complete diff changes no instrumentation test; the sole added test verifies DataStore persistence.
findings.impact: Successful existing UI jobs cannot establish the required InkPaper light/dark/large-font acceptance or actual startup and style-switch behavior.
findings.recommendation: Preserve legacy assertions and add explicit INK_PAPER and QUIET_GRID cases covering list, detail, settings, authentication, input states, and dialogs on API 26/35. Add MainActivity startup and persisted style/theme switching tests. Assert rendered colors, measured text layouts, callbacks, tags, and 48dp targets.

findings.claim: InkPaper fails the existing text-contrast requirement while the CI contrast guard reports success.
findings.evidence: Executed WCAG luminance calculations give InkPaperDark onAccent/cta (#FFFFFF/#E0653A) = 3.4471:1 and InkPaperLight tertiary/surface (#8A8175/#FFFFFF) = 3.8338:1. BiteButton uses onAccent/cta for enabled button labels; BiteTextField uses tertiary/surface for enabled placeholders. Baseline ratios are 13.3755:1 and 7.2528:1 respectively. verify_bite_visuals.py:35-36 selects only QuietGrid palettes; its retained CI entry point passed.
findings.impact: Normal-size save, authentication, and update button labels and light-mode placeholders fall below 4.5:1, without failing CI.
findings.recommendation: Correct these rendered color pairs and extend the verifier to both InkPaper palettes using actual component bindings. Retain all QuietGrid, vector, tag, and protected-hash assertions.

findings.claim: The new automatic launch-popup orchestration lacks activity-level acceptance tests.
findings.evidence: Existing UpdatesTest cases validate AppUpdateChecker state, and P6UpdateUiTest validates manual Settings callbacks. Neither executes this LaunchedEffect or its interaction with InAppUpdates and AuthRoot. No instrumentation test launches MainActivity. The new launchUpdateShown flag is ordinary remember state, while AppUpdateChecker is a singleton, making dismissal across activity recreation a concrete unverified lifecycle case.
findings.impact: The promised launch-only, once-only popup, opt-out behavior, manual-check separation, and absence of automatic downloads remain unverified.
findings.recommendation: Add MainActivity tests with controlled update responses: enabled/newer shows once; disabled, failed, equal, and older responses show nothing; manual checks retain their existing flow; dismissal survives recomposition and recreation; changing the toggle after startup follows launch-only semantics; no download starts without an explicit action. Exercise authenticated and login startup.

Require both styles' rendered text pairs to meet 4.5:1 and retain existing contrast, native-resource, vector, APK, and immutable-file guards.
